svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of fixture, drawn for 2026-07-15. Styled as fukinagashi, a windswept, read from how this account works. Season: summer. Maturity level 6 of 13, in a glazed pot. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
